Founder spec only required it in the OAuth-only-no-App state; showing it here is harmless but slightly noisy. Consider gating it with `&& !appPickerActive`. Non-blocking.

action_items: OPTIONAL / low priority: consider hiding the '▸ Or paste a Personal Access Token instead' disclosure link when appPickerActive === true (S3). Currently it still appears above the URL/branch inputs — harmless but slightly redundant since the user is already on the App path.
critical_code_review_comments: NewUserWizard.jsx line 99-129: the Promise.allSettled + install-first-then-oauth ordering is the correct fix — installs.length is the only signal that reliably means 'App can access repos', and the code now uses that as the sole gate for skipping the CTA. Legacy OAuth link only drives the reassurance badge and the PAT-fallback repo dropdown. Good.

NewUserWizard.jsx line 733: 'ghStatus === choosing && !patDisclosureOpen' — the disclosure link renders in both no-oauth-no-app AND app-installed states because both use ghStatus='choosing'. Consider also gating on !appPickerActive so the S3 UI stays clean (see design_issues above).

NewUserWizard.jsx line 749: connected-badge condition '(ghStatus=="connected" || (ghStatus=="choosing" && ghLogin && !appPickerActive))' is correct and delivers exactly the founder-requested behavior — verified in both S1 (no badge) and S2 (badge with correct login).

File length is now ~1082 lines — approaching the 700-line split threshold in the code-review guidelines. Consider splitting the step-1 GitHub-connect UI into a separate WizardStepConnect component in a future refactor.

context_for_next_testing_agent: To repro this test: (1) POST /api/aurem-dev/auth/signup with honeypot='' + form_age_ms>=3000 → get token; (2) direct Mongo write to dev_users.github = {login, connected_at, access_token: 'anything'} — access_token gate is what /oauth/status checks (found this the hard way: setting only 'connected_at' returned connected=false); (3) direct Mongo insert to github_installations with active=true; (4) log in via /login → /dashboard → wizard opens automatically (isWizardDismissed()===false && projects.length===0). data-testids in NewUserWizard.jsx: wizard-app-cta-block, wizard-app-install-btn, wizard-app-repo-picker, wizard-app-repo-<full_name>, wizard-app-repo-selected-cta, wizard-pat-disclosure-toggle, wizard-pat-input, wizard-gh-connected.
rca_of_the_issue: Confirmed by test: pre-fix, /github/oauth/status returned connected=true for OAuth-linked users, which set ghStatus='connected' — that state renders the URL/branch/PAT block WITHOUT the App CTA (line 749 old condition), and made the PAT input a REQUIRED field. Post-fix, ghStatus is derived ONLY from /github/app/installations length: >0 → picker, ==0 → 'choosing' (App CTA primary + PAT hidden behind disclosure). OAuth link status is now used solely to (a) populate ghLogin for the reassurance badge and (b) prefetch repos for the PAT-fallback dropdown. Verified end-to-end for the exact bug scenario (dev_users.github set, github_installations empty) — wizard now correctly shows 'Install Aurem for your repos [RECOMMENDED]' + 'Continue with GitHub App' as the sole primary CTA + green 'Connected as pattest_legacy_oauth_user' badge below the disclosure link.
